title: Do not flood the log
description:
Limit how many messages one source can log per second.

```
source 4120: 1000 messages in 1 s -> 10 logged, 990 suppressed
next second: "4120: 990 messages suppressed" then normal again
```
hints: A new window begins when `now - w.start >= 1.0` (lesson 4.02).
Return the lines to write, so the summary line can come before the new message.
requirements: At most 10 messages per source per second (a counter per source and window).
When a new window starts, log one summary line for the suppressed messages.
Use the time passed in, not the clock.
stretch: Use a token bucket instead and compare how bursts are handled.
